CBP, through a strategic partnership with American Exchange Group, a leader in fashion accessory, design, manufacturing, and distribution, together, closed the transaction on December 23, 2024.

Jonathan Adler®, founded three decades ago by the eponymous designer, is known for an innovative approach to décor, furniture, table-top, decorative accessories, lighting, full-scale residential and hospitality design. By delivering chic sophistication with a modern edge ­— an approach which Adler describes as ‘modern American glamour’ — the Jonathan Adler brand has garnered a loyal following.

The acquisition of Jonathan Adler® is CBP’s third acquisition in 18 months, following strategic investments in other high-growth, lifestyle-driven companies, including Draper James® and Outdoor Voices®. Both brands, with their strong emotional connection to consumers and distinctive design aesthetics, reinforce CBP’s commitment to building and nurturing brands that inspire and elevate everyday life.
